description: Portable corpus for the context-engine benchmark (benchmarks/bench-context.mjs). Each repo is pinned by URL + commit and checked out under a cache dir (default benchmarks/.corpus-cache, gitignored). The clio-coder ROOT entry always runs from this checkout; pinned repos that cannot be fetched (offline) are skipped with a warning so the benchmark still runs on whatever is available. The tracked baselines (context-baseline-main.json, context-after.json) were recorded on the author's earlier local corpus, so cross-run deltas only appear for repos whose names match.
